title: CredibilityParams
description: Expectations & credibility parameters. SPEC-CRED-4 (continuous credibility-weighted expectations) + SPEC-CRED-6 (mission-tied credibility).

target_inflation.description: Long-run inflation target expectations re-anchor toward and the inflation leg of the mission distance.

unemployment_target.description: Dual-mandate unemployment target — the unemployment leg of the mission distance.

expectations_adaptivity.description: How fast expectations track realized inflation when credibility is low (adaptive de-anchoring).

expectations_anchor_pull.description: How fast expectations are pulled toward target when credibility is high (re-anchoring). Scaled by the forward-guidance stance (SPEC-GUIDE-1).

credibility_mission_gain.description: Credibility points gained per unit reduction in dual-mandate distance per month. Higher = more responsive.

credibility_unemployment_weight.description: Weight on the unemployment gap in the dual-mandate distance. < 1 makes disinflation progress dominate so winning the inflation fight builds credibility through a recession.

anchor_threshold.description: Credibility below this counts as a month 'below anchor' for the persistent-memory stat (months_below_anchor).
